name: Olise
bio: Michael Olise is a highly talented French winger known for his exceptional dribbling and creative vision. He played a pivotal role for France at the Paris Olympics, scoring crucial goals and providing key assists to lead his country to a prestigious Silver Medal.

name: O. Dembélé
bio: Ousmane Dembélé is an explosive forward renowned for his incredible pace, world-class dribbling, and rare dual-footed ability. He remains a highly influential figure for both Paris Saint-Germain and the French national team in major international tournaments.

name: LAMINE YAMAL
bio: Lamine Yamal is one of football's finest young prodigies, making history with FC Barcelona and Spain. He took the footballing world by storm during UEFA Euro 2024, winning the Young Player of the Tournament award and helping Spain capture the European championship title.

name: MBAPPÉ
bio: Kylian Mbappé stands as one of the most clinical and dangerous forwards in world football. Renowned for his devastating speed and lethal finishing, the World Cup winner and multiple-time Ligue 1 top scorer consistently dominates at both club and international levels.

name: HAALAND
bio: Erling Haaland is a powerhouse striker celebrated for his astonishing goal-scoring record, immense physical strength, and perfect positioning. He shattered numerous Premier League records with Manchester City, establishing himself as an unstoppable force in the penalty box.

name: KANE
bio: Harry Kane is a world-class playmaker and striker, serving as England's all-time leading goal scorer. Known for his elite finishing and extraordinary passing range, he achieved incredible individual success in the Bundesliga with Bayern Munich, securing Europe's Golden Shoe.

name: BELLINGHAM
bio: Jude Bellingham is a complete, dynamic midfielder possessing elite technical abilities, physical dominance, and a remarkable eye for goal. He enjoyed a spectacular debut season with Real Madrid, capturing both the La Liga and UEFA Champions League trophies.

name: PEDRI
bio: Pedri is a master midfield maestro praised for his magical close control, composure under pressure, and elite passing precision. A vital core player for FC Barcelona and Spain, he played an integral role in controlling the midfield during Spain's triumphant Euro 2024 campaign.

name: DIMARCO
bio: Federico Dimarco is a highly versatile defender and wing-back famed for his exceptional left-footed crossing ability and tactical intelligence. He has been an essential pillar for Inter Milan's defensive line and Scudetto success, as well as the Italian national squad.

name: RICE
bio: Declan Rice is an elite, robust defensive midfielder known for his superb interception skills, ball-carrying power, and immense stamina. He heavily fortified Arsenal's midfield structure and played a crucial role in leading England to back-to-back European Championship finals.

name: HAKIMI
bio: Achraf Hakimi is a world-class full-back celebrated for his incredible pace, attacking threat, and exceptional stamina. He serves as a vital pillar for Paris Saint-Germain and led the Moroccan national team to a historic semi-final run at the FIFA World Cup.

name: GABRIEL
bio: Gabriel Magalhães is a rock-solid left-footed central defender known for his immense physical power, elite aerial dominance, and precise tackling. He has established himself as an irreplaceable defensive leader for both Arsenal and the Brazilian national squad.

name: VITINHA
bio: Vitinha is an elegant midfield maestro praised for his magical close control, composure under heavy pressure, and elite passing precision. He orchestrates the tempo beautifully for Paris Saint-Germain and continues to be a crucial technical asset for Portugal.

name: RAPHINHA
bio: Raphinha is a dynamic, high-workrate winger known for his lethal left-footed long shots, explosive dribbling, and incredible defensive contribution. He stands out as a key attacking threat and creative force for both FC Barcelona and the Brazilian national team.

name: B. FERNANDES
bio: Bruno Fernandes is an elite attacking playmaker celebrated for his world-class vision, tireless work ethic, and extraordinary key passing. As the influential captain of Manchester United, he is equally indispensable as a main goal-scorer and creator for Portugal.

name: VINI JR.
bio: Vinícius Júnior is one of the most devastating and thrilling wingers in modern football, world-renowned for his frightening acceleration, elite trickery, and clutch goals. He plays a monumental role in Real Madrid's domestic and UEFA Champions League triumphs.

name: VALVERDE
bio: Federico Valverde is the ultimate engine room midfielder, uniquely mixing explosive pace, relentless physical power, and lethal long-range shooting. He remains an absolutely vital core asset for Real Madrid's success and the Uruguayan national team.

name: DONNARUMMA
bio: Gianluigi Donnarumma is a commanding, elite goalkeeper famous for his incredible reflex saves, massive physical frame, and supreme penalty-saving record. He anchors the backline masterfully for Paris Saint-Germain and the Italian national squad.

name: RODRIGO
bio: Rodrigo (Rodri) is widely regarded as the premier defensive midfielder in world football, possessing incomparable tactical intelligence, elite passing, and physical dominance. He serves as the core anchor for Manchester City and Spain's international dominance.

name: LAUTARO
bio: Lautaro Martínez is a lethal and clinical centre-forward renowned for his elite predatory movement, relentless high pressing, and explosive finishing. He captains Inter Milan beautifully and consistently delivers crucial clutch goals for Argentina.

name: N. MENDES
bio: Nuno Mendes is a lightning-fast left-back known for his electric acceleration, sharp dribbling, and exceptional recovery pace. He provides immense defensive stability and overlapping attacking threat for both Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.

name: JOÃO NEVES
bio: João Neves is a highly-rated, dynamic midfield prodigy admired for his relentless work rate, excellent ball retention, and tactical maturity. He dictates the game's tempo with composure and is rapidly evolving into a key engine for club and country.

name: M. SALAH
bio: Mohamed Salah is a global football superstar and one of the most prolific wingers in Premier League history. Renowned for his world-class finishing, explosive pace, and sharp inside cuts, the Egyptian King remains a legendary talisman for Liverpool.

name: RAYA
bio: David Raya is an elite, modern shot-stopper celebrated for his extraordinary distribution skills, quick reflexes, and command of his penalty area. He has firmly established himself as an irreplaceable defensive anchor and vital playmaker from the back for Arsenal.

name: BASTONI
bio: Alessandro Bastoni is a world-class, elegant left-footed center-back known for his superb ball-playing ability, tactical intelligence, and precise tackling. He serves as a cornerstone of Inter Milan's rock-solid defense and a key figure for the Azzurri.

name: SAKA
bio: Bukayo Saka is a sensational and highly creative winger recognized for his elite technical ability, direct dribbling, and clutch goal-scoring. As Arsenal's starboy and a pivotal winger for England, his consistency makes him one of the world's finest talents.

name: A.BECKER
bio: Alisson Becker is a legendary goalkeeper globally renowned for his masterful 1v1 shot-stopping, elite positioning, and calmness under pressure. He is widely considered one of the pillars behind Liverpool and Brazil's defensive blockades over the years.

name: SALIBA
bio: William Saliba is a phenomenal defensive heavyweight praised for his calm elegance, recovery speed, and perfect tackling execution. He has fast established himself as one of the best center-backs in Europe, anchoring both Arsenal and France's backline.

name: SZOBOSZLAI
bio: Dominik Szoboszlai is an explosive attacking midfielder known for his incredible long-range shooting, physical power, and exceptional dead-ball delivery. He acts as a versatile creative engine for Liverpool and leads the Hungarian national team with pride.

name: VIRGIL
bio: Virgil van Dijk is a legendary defensive titan widely praised for his immense physical dominance, leadership, and unshakeable composure. As a premier captain for both Liverpool and the Netherlands, he continues to be the ultimate benchmark for modern defenders.

name: HAKAN ÇALHANOĞLU
bio: Hakan Çalhanoğlu is a world-class deep-lying playmaker renowned for his exceptional vision, elite passing range, and devastating set-piece delivery. He dictates the midfield tempo beautifully for Inter Milan and stands as the proud leader of the Turkish national team.

name: KHVICHA KVARATSKHELIA
bio: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is a dynamic and unpredictable winger celebrated for his explosive dribbling, direct attacking style, and brilliant flair. Popularly known as 'Kvaradona', he is a crucial creative catalyst for Napoli and the talismanic spearhead of Georgia.

name: LUIS DÍAZ
bio: Luis Díaz is an electric, high-energy winger feared for his blistering pace, sharp trickery, and relentless work rate on the left flank. He consistently creates dangerous goal-scoring opportunities, making him an invaluable asset for Liverpool and Colombia.

name: JULIÁN ALVAREZ
bio: Julián Alvarez is a highly versatile, relentless forward admired for his intelligent movement, lethal finishing, and aggressive pressing. Having won the sport's biggest trophies at a young age, 'El Araña' continues to shine as a top-tier attacker for club and country.

name: MOISÉS CAICEDO
bio: Moisés Caicedo is a phenomenal powerhouse in defensive midfield, celebrated for his elite stamina, structural positioning, and robust tackling. He excels at breaking opposition transitions, solidifying his role as Chelsea's midfield engine and Ecuador's crown jewel.

name: LIONEL MESSI
bio: Lionel Messi is widely regarded as the greatest football player of all time. With unparalleled close control, legendary playmaking vision, and masterclass finishing capability, the iconic forward continues to orchestrate magic and inspire football generations worldwide.

name: NICOLÒ BARELLA
bio: Nicolò Barella is an incredibly dynamic, box-to-box midfielder praised for his relentless engine, technical versatility, and brilliant transition play. His energetic work rate and creative driving runs make him indispensable for Inter Milan and Italy.

name: THEO HERNANDEZ
bio: Theo Hernandez is an explosive, attacking left-back famous for his lung-bursting forward runs, physical dominance, and clinical goal threat. He acts as a crucial overlapping playmaker, bringing immense firepower to AC Milan and the French national squad.

name: VICTOR OSIMHEN
bio: Victor Osimhen is a world-class, elite striker celebrated for his blistering raw pace, phenomenal aerial threat, and clinical predatory finishing. His high-intensity attacking work rate makes him a nightmare for opposition backlines globally.

name: SCOTT MCTOMINAY
bio: Scott McTominay is a physically imposing, hard-working box-to-box midfielder renowned for his immense aerial presence, clutch goal-scoring ability, and defensive grit. He commands the center of the pitch with passion for both Napoli and Scotland.

name: FLORIAN WIRTZ
bio: Florian Wirtz is a sensationally gifted attacking midfielder known for his incredible close control, defense-splitting passes, and remarkable tactical maturity. He serves as a dynamic creative spark plug capable of unlocking the tightest defenses for club and country.

name: BRUNO GUIMARÃES
bio: Bruno Guimarães is a highly complete, orchestrating central midfielder who blends technical elegance with aggressive defensive work. His ability to break lines with physics-defying passes and retain possession under intense pressure makes him a vital midfield anchor.

name: JULES KOUNDÉ
bio: Jules Koundé is an incredibly versatile and agile defender who transitions seamlessly between center-back and right-back duties. Renowned for his tactical intelligence, sharp recovery pace, and superb technical ability on the ball, he builds plays cleanly from the back line.

name: GLEISON BREMER
bio: Gleison Bremer is a physically dominant powerhouse of a center-back, revered for his elite aerial presence, uncompromising tackling, and supreme structural positioning. He commands defensive zones with immense authority, shutting down opposition attacks cleanly.

name: DAYOT UPAMECANO
bio: Dayot Upamecano is an imposing central defender equipped with blistering raw recovery speed, immense physical strength, and sharp ball-playing qualities. He excels at breaking opposition transitions early and stepping forward confidently to initiate structural attacks.

name: ALEJANDRO GRIMALDO
bio: Alejandro Grimaldo is an exceptionally creative, attacking left wing-back celebrated for his world-class crossing accuracy, precise set-piece execution, and elite passing range. He behaves like a seasoned playmaker on the flank, offering massive offensive versatility.

name: WILLIAN PACHO
bio: Willian Pacho is a rising defensive rock, distinguished by his elite tackling efficiency, immense concentration, and highly stable positioning. As a left-footed center-back, he provides perfect structural balance and exceptional composure under high press.

name: TONI KROOS
bio: Toni Kroos is a legendary midfield maestro widely regarded as one of the greatest deep-lying playmakers in football history. Equipped with surgical, millimeter-precise passing accuracy and masterclass calm, he controls the entire tempo of matches effortlessly.

name: ROBERT LEWANDOWSKI
bio: Robert Lewandowski is an iconic, elite goal-scoring striker famed for his textbook lethal finishing, clinical positional awareness, and exceptional physical hold-up play. He consistently ranks among the most ruthless and reliable goalscorers of the modern era.

name: MARCOS LLORENTE
bio: Marcos Llorente is an extraordinary Swiss-army-knife athlete celebrated for his blistering top-end speed, outstanding stamina, and immense tactical flexibility. Capable of operating elite shifts at right-back or central midfield, he injects endless power into his team.

name: KARIM BENZEMA
bio: Karim Benzema is a world-class, complete forward celebrated for his brilliant link-up play, exceptional tactical intelligence, and lethal finishing. He functions beautifully as both a primary goal scorer and a creative catalyst in the attacking third.

name: FRENKIE DE JONG
bio: Frenkie de Jong is an exceptionally elegant, line-breaking central midfielder famed for his press-resistance, elite ball progression, and vision. He glides past opposition defenders effortlessly to transition his team from defense to heavy attack.

name: KEVIN DE BRUYNE
bio: Kevin De Bruyne is a legendary attacking midfielder widely regarded as one of the finest playmakers of his generation. His unparalleled cross field vision, surgical crossing ability, and powerful long range shooting make him an absolute offensive force.

name: RYAN GRAVENBERCH
bio: Ryan Gravenberch is a dynamic, physically gifted box-to-box midfielder who uses his towering height and supreme technical composure to anchor the midfield. He excels at disrupting transitions and breaking forward using high gear long strides.

name: PHIL FODEN
bio: Phil Foden is a uniquely creative and exceptionally agile attacking midfielder blessed with mesmerizing close control and quick-turn body mechanics. He moves fluidly across space, unlocking rigid modern low blocks with absolute ease.

name: JURRIEN TIMBER
bio: Jurrien Timber is a versatile, rapid, and modern defensive asset who transitions flawlessly between full-back and center-back assignments. He reads oncoming game traffic with great vision and builds comfortably from the back row.

name: ADRIEN RABIOT
bio: Adrien Rabiot is a highly athletic, robust box-to-box engine known for his commanding physical height, strong aerial ability, and excellent tactical positioning. He protects lines securely while offering strong driving power into structural space.

name: ALEXIS MAC ALLISTER
bio: Alexis Mac Allister is a highly intelligent, technically gifted midfielder who dictates the tempo of play with clean short passing and brilliant spatial awareness. He keeps possession secure under extreme pressure, stabilizing transitioning lanes perfectly.

name: KALIDOU KOULIBALY
bio: Kalidou Koulibaly is an imposing, physically dominant central defender revered for his immense tackling power, superior aerial authority, and reliable recovery speed. He commands defensive setups cleanly, completely locking out opposition targets.

name: LEROY SANÉ
bio: Leroy Sané is an incredibly explosive winger equipped with terrifying raw acceleration, elite dribbling tricks, and a clinical left foot. He terrorizes touchlines and deep defensive ranks, easily slashing inward to generate high quality chances.

name: JOŠKO GVARDIOL
bio: Josko Gvardiol is a highly versatile and technically gifted modern defender who excels at both center-back and left-back. Renowned for his composure on the ball, elite recovery pace, and proactive tackling, he is exceptional at initiating attacks from deep defensive lines.

name: GRANIT XHAKA
bio: Granit Xhaka is a commanding deep-lying playmaker known for his elite passing range, tactical leadership, and exceptional stamina. He serves as the absolute engine of the midfield, orchestrating transitions and shielding the backline with great physical discipline.

name: MARTÍN ZUBIMENDI
bio: Martin Zubimendi is an incredibly composed defensive midfielder celebrated for his tactical awareness, press-resistance, and clean ball distribution. He excels at reading opposition plays, intercepting key transitions, and maintaining technical structural balance.

name: TIJJANI REIJNDERS
bio: Tijjani Reijnders is a dynamic, elegant box-to-box central midfielder famed for his ball progression, high motor stamina, and sharp spatial control. He drives into dangerous spaces easily, linking midfield setups to operational attacking third patterns flawlessly.

name: SERGEJ MILINKOVIĆ-SAVIĆ
bio: Sergej Milinkovic-Savic is a physically imposing, aerial powerhouse in central midfield who combines towering strength with majestic attacking vision. He represents an elite target inside the box while offering brilliant long-range finishing power.

name: SANDRO TONALI
bio: Sandro Tonali is an explosive, high-intensity defensive midfielder characterized by his exceptional speed, tenacious work-rate, and aggressive tackling style. He works relentlessly to break up opposition plays and spark fast vertical counter-attacks.

name: VIKTOR GYÖKERES
bio: Viktor Gyokeres is a lethal, highly explosive modern center-forward possessing terrifying acceleration, extreme strength, and clinical finishing. He thrives on bullying defenders in physical duels, running channels, and hammering goals from any angle.

name: MARCUS THURAM
bio: Marcus Thuram is a physically dominant, blistering fast central forward who links up attacking transitions seamlessly with his elite close control. His combination of height, raw pace, and intelligent inside-the-box movement makes him a multi-faceted offensive asset.

name: AURÉLIEN TCHOUAMÉNI
bio: Aurelien Tchouameni is an elite defensive anchor known for his world-class tactical positioning, structural awareness, and physical dominance. He shields back rows effortlessly, winning crucial aerial battles and recovering balls with precision tackles.

name: MARCOS AOÁS CORRÊA
bio: Marquinhos is a world-class, highly intelligent central defender celebrated for his exceptional timing, elite tackling stats, and outstanding defensive leadership. He commands defensive lines brilliantly, closing down operational spaces with absolute efficiency.
